## Homepage Content

### Positioning
I build production platforms — AI systems, real-time collaboration — end to end, solo. Most recently: the microservices platform behind Moburst's AI marketing suite, an agency whose clients include Samsung, Reddit, Uber, and Google. Before that, a decade of WebRTC classrooms, threat intelligence, and enterprise systems, each built and run by one architect.

### Verified figures
- 10+ years engineering
- 19 documented platforms (each case study written from the source code)
- ~7 years: longest solo-run production system (Contribute Cloud, 2016–2024)
- 4 AI products running under one SSO login (Moburst.ai)

## Capabilities

### AI Integration & Platforms
Multi-LLM systems across OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity; FastAPI microservices with handoff-token SSO and five-tier role-based access control; a reusable dual-language Auth SDK (Python + TypeScript/Bun); structured-output pipelines; atomic-swap GCP deployments with health-gated automatic rollback.

### Real-time Systems
WebRTC casting and live video (OpenVidu), Socket.io collaboration (live whiteboards, polls, chat, tool broadcasting), multi-cast grids of student streams, and browser-based remote control of Android display fleets. A decade of shipping systems where latency is the product.

### Full-Stack Delivery, Solo
Backend, frontend, database, infrastructure, and DevOps from one architect: React/Next.js, Node.js and Python, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, GCP/AWS/DigitalOcean with Docker, deploys, backups, and rollbacks handled end to end.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: What makes you different from other full-stack developers?
I build entire platforms alone — backend, frontend, database, infrastructure, and deployment. Recent work includes the microservices platform behind an agency's AI product suite (clients include Samsung, Reddit, Uber, and Google) and a WebRTC classroom platform I built and maintained solo for about seven years. Track record: 19 documented projects, each case study written from the source code.

### Q: Do you work with international clients remotely?
Yes — primarily US and UK clients, remotely from Lahore, Pakistan, with clear communication and flexible scheduling across time zones.

### Q: What are your rates?
$45/hour for consulting and development, or project-based quotes.

### Q: What technologies do you specialize in?
AI platform engineering (FastAPI microservices, multi-LLM integrations), WebRTC and Socket.io for real-time communication, React/Next.js, Node.js and Python, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, GCP/Docker deployment pipelines.

### Q: Can you handle both frontend and backend development?
Yes — complete project development from database design to user interface, including APIs, real-time features, security, and deployment automation.

### Q: What's your typical project timeline and process?
Enterprise projects typically run 5–18 months: requirement analysis, architecture design, iterative development with regular demos, testing, and deployment, with constant communication throughout.

### Q: Do you provide ongoing support after project completion?
Yes — maintenance, bug fixes, feature enhancements, and technical support as long-term partnerships.

## Project Portfolio Summary

19 documented platforms at https://maxifjaved.com/projects — highlights:

### AI Marketing & Platforms (Moburst)
- **Moburst.ai** — Microservices platform behind Moburst's Growth Labs AI suite: centralized FastAPI auth, handoff-token SSO, dual-language Auth SDK, five-tier RBAC, GCP deploys with health-gated rollback. Four AI tools under one login.
- **AEO Analytics** — AI answer-engine brand-visibility analytics: unified multi-LLM client across OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.
- **Intercept** — AI social intelligence & engagement platform.
- **AI Community Engagement Automation Engine** — Reddit community automation.
- **Moburst Growth Labs Satellite Sites** — automated AI content platform.

### Educational Technology & Interactive Displays
- **Contribute Cloud** — zero-install, browser-based classroom collaboration and screen-casting platform (WebRTC/OpenVidu + Socket.io), built and maintained solo for ~7 years; 15 teaching tools and 42 educational games; deployed to schools.
- **Contribute Signage** — cloud digital signage platform.
- **TouchIT App Store 3.0** — custom Android app distribution: native Kotlin client (Dagger2, Retrofit2, RxJava2), React/Redux web, Node/Express backend.
- **TouchIT Air** — Android AirPlay receiver.
- **JustCastIt / Wireless Wizard** — browser-based wireless screen casting for interactive LED displays.
- **Just Annotate** — offline whiteboard app.

### Cybersecurity & Infrastructure
- **TIPX** — threat-intelligence platform integrating MISP + OpenCTI with custom APIs and world-globe visualization; built solo in 14 months; white-label ready.
- **ManageMyLED** — MDM & remote-control portal for fleets of Android interactive displays (dozens to hundreds of panels): remote lock, reboot, silent APK install, live browser-based remote control over WebRTC. Web portal built solo (132 commits, 29 API routes, 12-model schema).
- **Altconsole** — enterprise cloud infrastructure management frontend.

### Business Intelligence & SaaS
- **CrystalBall.pro** — AI-powered marketing analytics with automated GA annotations and AI insights; 4,000+ app integrations via Zapier; AppSumo-listed. Joined at V2 and evolved into lead developer.
- **LifeMIB** — insurance lead-management CRM with a custom Zapier app integrating 8,000+ apps and Twilio automation.
- **Athlacer** — sports venue booking: React Native app (57 screens) with split-payment booking flows.
- **Build A Hot Tub** — browser-based 3D pool & hot-tub configurator (Three.js/R3F, custom GLSL water shaders) with Stripe payments and PDF export.

## Technical Approach

### Development Philosophy
- End-to-end ownership: one architect accountable for backend, frontend, data, infrastructure, and deployment
- Production-first: real deploy pipelines, backups, rollbacks, and monitoring — not demos
- Verified claims: every metric in these case studies traces to the source code
- Progressive enhancement: platforms work without heavy client-side dependencies

### Project Management
- Requirement analysis and architecture design before code
- Iterative development with regular demos
- Clear written communication across time zones
- Long-term maintenance partnerships after launch
